# EggRateToday — Today's Egg Rate in India

> Daily verified NECC wholesale & retail egg prices for every major state and city across India, updated every morning.

## Core Pages & Features
- [Today's National Egg Rate](https://eggratetoday.com/): Live national average egg prices (per piece, dozen, 30-egg tray, 210-egg peti).
- [State-wise Egg Rates](https://eggratetoday.com/states): Comprehensive daily egg prices across all states in India.
- [City-wise Egg Rates](https://eggratetoday.com/cities): City-level egg rate listings for Delhi, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Namakkal, Bengaluru, Kolkata, Pune, and more.
- [Egg Rate History & Trends](https://eggratetoday.com/trends): Interactive price charts, historical data, and rate fluctuations over time.
- [AI Market Analysis](https://eggratetoday.com/egg-market-analysis): AI-driven daily egg market summary, price forecasts, and market insights.
- [Compare City Rates](https://eggratetoday.com/compare/mumbai-vs-pune): Side-by-side comparison of wholesale & retail rates between any two cities.

## Data Structure & Units
- **Per Piece**: Base price per single egg.
- **Per Dozen**: Price for 12 eggs.
- **Per Tray**: Standard wholesale tray of 30 eggs.
- **Per Peti**: Standard wholesale crate of 210 eggs.
- **Per 100 Eggs**: NECC standard benchmark rate for 100 eggs.
- **Price Types**: Wholesale (mandi/NECC declared) and Retail (market consumer price).

## Information Sources
- National Egg Coordination Committee (NECC)
- Local wholesale mandi declarations
- Daily verified editor updates
